notes.title: Update 1.4.1
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone, 

We already replaced an old answer system in our game in a previous patch(1.4.0)

Some levels are already support original city names on a local language. (it's what you asked for!). This system was enabled by default.
Old drag&drop system was replaced but you can still enable it in main menu

This small update will add only a minor fixes, like mouseover hover text in all ingame menus.
If you didn't tried our game yet, you can buy it on sale right now.

Thank you for your time, have a great week!

notes.title: Update 1.4.0 (reworked in-game answer system)
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone, 

This update will bring a new answer system to our game.

Now you can type your answer! Some levels will support original city names on a local language. (it's what you asked for!). This system will be enabled by default.
Old drag&drop system was replaced but you can still enable it in main menu


We still want to improve our game. It's only a small part of our big update, which will be released in a near future.

Thank you for your time, have a good day!

notes.title: Update 1.3.0. 150 new levels added to quiz mode
notes.notes:
Changelog:

150 new levels added to quiz mode
Fixed some text errors


We finished our work on a new game mode, it should be available at the end of december. Now we are start working on game localization, we have plans to support (Russian, French, German, Portuguese, Polish, Czech, Dutch, Spanish, Italian) languages. Most of translations are already complete. "Localization update" will available in January.

Thank for your time. Have a good weekend! ːHappyRobː

notes.title: Update 1.2.0. New hint system,game optimisation, itch.io release
notes.notes:
Changelog:

Added a new hint system("Easy mode"). You can enable it in game options. This system will show you correct letters each 2-3 mins. Also game can run in background. So, if you can't guess a city, you can minimise your game and wait a few mins for a correct answer.
Game data was optimised and now game size is only 2 GB(55% less than before)
Fixed some text errors


Now game is available on Itch♪io (It comes with steam key and have a 50% discount) ːHappyRobː
